spans.s:
पोट पोट, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. पुट्),
the foundation of a house [cf. पोत]; putting to-
gether, uniting, mixing; (आ), f. a woman with a
beard; a hermaphrodite; a female servant or slave;
(ई), f. the rectum; a large alligator.
—पोट-गल,
अस्, m. a species of reed, Arundo Tibialis; a kind
of grass, Saccharum Spontaneum; a fish.
पोटाय, Nom. A. पोटायते, &c., = पोटां कृ.

पोटलक पोटलक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
or पोटलिका, f. a bundle or packet.
पोटिक पोटिक, अस्, m. a boil.

पोट्टिल पोट्टिल, अस्, m. (with Jainas) N. of
the ninth Arhat of the future Ut-sarpiṇī.
